page_title: TERA STUDIO — Hear yourself sing any song

sources.entry: Tera Studio - Learns your singing voice from about a minute of singing, then sings any song you upload back in your voice, in any language. #freemium

summary.name: TERA Studio
summary.one_liner: TERA Studio is a web-based AI voice studio that learns your singing voice from about a minute of singing and then re-sings any song you upload in your own voice.
use_cases: Hearing your own voice sing a favorite song
Making a personalized song gift for someone
Creating TikTok, Reels or Shorts covers
Converting a demo or your own track to your vocal
Trying out a song you could never quite hit
summary.what_it_does: TERA learns your singing voice from about 1 to 2 minutes of singing recorded in the browser or uploaded as a file. You then upload a song you have rights to (up to 20 minutes and 150 MB, with up to 5 minutes converted per version) and it returns the same performance with the vocal replaced by your trained voice, keeping phrasing, breaths, vibrato and dynamics. It supports 12 languages including English, Spanish, Japanese, Korean and Hindi. Finished songs can be downloaded as full-quality WAV files or as vertical song-card videos with 15, 30 or 60-second clips.
notable: Keeps the original performance and changes only the voice, rather than generating new melodies
Voice is locked to the owner's account and cloning requires consent
Song-card videos sized for TikTok, Reels and Shorts
Two free full-song previews before paying
caveats: Downloads (WAV and song-card videos) require a paid Starter ($8.99/mo) or Creator ($19.99/mo) plan; free accounts only listen on the website
Monthly finished-minute allowances (30 or 90) that do not roll over; subscriptions are non-refundable
Only songs you made or have permission to transform; streaming links are not supported
